title: Twisting a tester transcript
statement: Let $T$ be a nonadaptive function tester with a finite seed space, let $f$ and $\phi$ map its query domain to the signs $\{\pm1\}$, and fix a seed. If each answered query is multiplied by $\phi$ at its query point, the resulting transcript is exactly the transcript obtained by querying the pointwise product $x\mapsto f(x)\phi(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive function tester with finite seed space
